findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Several boxes of candy were stored on the floor in the upstairs storeroom near the sign indicating that all boxes need to be stored off the ground. All foods are required to be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Ensure that foods are stored properly to prevent contamination. 

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the waste receptacle in front of the store to be overflowing with refuse which has been allowed to sit on top of the receptacle and fallen off to the sides of the receptacle. Some refuse has accumulated around the dumpster as well. Additionally, bags of refuse are piled in front of the back door of the store room. Operator states that the receptacles were to be emptied yesterday but they were not. Ensure that waste is removed from receptacles at a frequency that eliminates nuisance/harborage conditions such as this. 

5-502.11: REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be removed from the PREMISES at a frequency that will minimize the development of objectionable odors and other conditions that attract or harbor insects and rodents.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Food stored on ground. Needs to be 6 inches off ground.

Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed the frozen foods cooler to have an accumulation of ice build up on the left hand fan. Ice build up has fallen on top frozen food product. Defrost and maintain freezer to provide a smooth, cleanable surface.750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were observed to be soiled: (1) the bottom of the reach in cooler storing milk and eggs with an accumulation of dust and food debris, (2) the bottom of the frozen foods cooler with an accumulation of dust and food debris, and (3) the bottom of the ice cream cooler with an accumulation of food and dust debris.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service items, such as paper towels, to be stored on the floor in the back storage area. Single service items shall be stored six inches above the ground.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Coolers holding milk, eggs and landshire sandwiches do not have thermometers. 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide proper thermometers to these coolers, accurate to + or - 3 degrees and located to be easily readable.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Boxes of candy are on the floor in the back stock area. 750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food. Provide proper shelving so that food is protected and 6 inches off of the floor.

Properly store single use items.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The tiles in front of the urinal in the men's rest room are in disrepair. The restroom has an odor. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
Floors in the back are soiled throughout both down and up stairs. They have low sitting shelves or boxes directly on the floor which allow soil and cardboard to build up under and around shelves. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors and maintain them clean.

Seal the wall so that it is non-absorbant and easily cleanable.
